title: Manuscript
toolbar.label: Manuscript toolbar
toolbar.buildingCurrent: The current revision is being built
tablet.label: Screen area
archived.title: Project archived — read-only
archived.body: You can still view, compare revisions and export. Saving, building, file operations and Change Proposal decisions are off. Restore the project in Research Projects to edit again.
files.title: Files and outline
editor.label: Content of {{path}}
editor.none: Choose a file in the file tree to open it.
editor.noPreview: No preview for {{path}}. The file is still built and exported.
init.lead: This project has no manuscript yet. Choose how to start; each project has one LaTeX manuscript, compiled with pdfLaTeX, references through natbib.
init.Default.title: Default — article template
init.Default.gives: Creates main.tex with title and author, sections/introduction.tex and bibliography/references.bib. Good for a new paper.
init.Blank.title: Blank — empty
init.Blank.gives: Creates only a minimal main.tex and bibliography/references.bib. Good when you will build the structure or upload files yourself.
init.note: Starting creates revision 1 by System. Then you edit directly or review Writing Agent Change Proposals.
init.archived: The project is archived, so no manuscript can be started.
save.kept: Your text stays in the editor and is kept locally. Saving again will not create a duplicate revision.
conflict.label: Save conflict
conflict.title: {{path}} changed on the server
conflict.goneTitle: {{path}} is not in the current revision
conflict.kept: Nothing was sent; your changes are still in the editor.
conflict.diffLabel: Differences between the server version and yours
draft.label: Unsaved changes
draft.title: Unsaved changes from last time
draft.body: {{path}} has edits you did not save. Restore them to continue, or drop the draft to keep the server version.
draft.stale: {{path}} has edits you did not save, and the file changed on the server since. After restoring, saving will ask which version to keep.
bib.label: references.bib
bib.readOnly: Generated by System from Trusted References — do not edit by hand. Add a reference by choosing its key while typing \cite{.
cite.unresolvedBody: No Trusted Reference with this key in the project.
cite.revokedBody: The reference of this key is {{status}}, no longer a Trusted Reference. Replace it before submitting.
cite.addsEntry: added to the bibliography when chosen
cite.emptyTitle: The project has no Trusted Reference yet
cite.emptyReason: Only the project’s Trusted References can be cited. Choose references in References and Evidence.
cite.noMatchReason: Suggestions only include the project’s Trusted References.
cite.addFailed: Could not add the reference to the bibliography
error.base_revision_mismatch: The manuscript has a newer revision.
error.project_archived: The project is archived; the manuscript cannot change.
error.citation_check_failed: The citation check did not pass, so it cannot be accepted.
error.reference_not_trusted: This reference is not a Trusted Reference of the project.
error.invalid_transition: The state changed elsewhere; the screen reloaded.
error.validation_failed: The data sent is not valid.
